name: @streamline-pulse/creeba-oplog-prisma
description: Prisma binding for @streamline-pulse/creeba-oplog: transparent mutation capture ($extends), a ready-made OpStore and Projection. One schema covers relational connectors (pg/mysql/sqlite/cockroach); a Mongo variant (synthetic key) is provided. The app only declares its syncable entities.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../scripts/fix-dts.mjs dist
